author: EveCogs
name: Support
description: A comprehensive support system that replaces Red's built-in contact and dm commands with enhanced features including categories, channels, customizable greetings, anonymous mode, logging, and user blocking.
install_msg: Thanks for installing Support! Use `[p]supportset` to configure categories and channels. This cog overrides the built-in `contact` and `dm` commands with more features.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores Discord user IDs, guild IDs, channel IDs, and message content for support functionality.
